Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section D.1(b) | Description :Call for Subprojects proposal and selected Communities, publiclydisclosed. | Frequency :Monthly
Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section D.1(c) | Description :Community Investment Subproject proposals to comply with selectioncriteria set forth in the Operational Manual. | Frequency :Quarterly
Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section D.2 | Description :Second Community Investment Subprojects to comply with Genderprioritization requirements | Frequency :Monthly

Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section D.3 | Description :Recipient to enter into CI Grant Agreements (sub-financing agreements)with Communities for the financing of selected Community Investment Subprojects | Frequency :Quarterly

Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section I.A.1(b) | Description :Strengthen the Unidad Desconcentrada Empoderar through therecruitment and set-up of a Project Coordination Team (PCT). | Due Date :31-Jan-2012
Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section I.A.1(c) | Description :Establish, at least two Regional Operating Units reportingadministratively to the PCT | Due Date :31-Jan-2012

Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section I.A.1(e) | Description :Cause participating municipalities to establish Municipal Committeesfor the endorsements of Community Investment Subprojects. | Frequency :Monthly
Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section I.C | Description :Prepare and furnish to the Association detailed annual operating plans |Frequency :Yearly
Finance Agreement :Schedule 2, Section III.D | Description :Procurement audits to be carried out by independent auditors |Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :Section I. D. 1. (a) of Schedule 2 | Description :Prior to the implementation of any Subproject, the Recipientthrough EMPODERAR shall, when applicable, enter into a memorandum of understanding with each Participating Municipality where thoseCommunities are located, under terms and conditions acceptable to the Association and substantially similar to those provided inthe OM. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Section I. D. 1. (b) of Schedule 2 | Description :Prior to the implementation of Subprojects, the Recipientthrough EMPODERAR shall, upon having selected a Community Investment Subproject, enter into a written agreement with each Communityor cluster thereof, as the case may be, for the provision of the respective Community Investment Grant, on terms and conditionsacceptable to the Association. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Section I.A.1. (c) of schedule 2 | Description :The Recipient shall vest the overall responsibility for theimplementation of the Project in the MDRyT, and to this end shall, through MDRyT no later than three (3) months after the EffectiveDate complete the staffing of the ROUs, in a manner acceptable to the Bank. | Due Date :28-Feb-2017
